checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices.
The list does not price a separate basic services fee on its own line; it uses the casket-included fee approach, so there is no basic-services includesText to assess.
The only mandatory overhead charge described is the $2,195 basic services fee; no other mandatory facilities, handling, or staff fee appears.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states embalming is needed for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket funeral without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered and the list states an alternative container can be used, with no statement that a casket is needed.
The direct cremation description lists what is included but the list shows no cash-advance section billing a separate crematory fee.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered good or service lacks its own line.
The list contains only itemized goods and services and the four required single-price items, with no optional combination package.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery, or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of the required disclosures themselves.
No text claims that a product delays decomposition or protects the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts the required statements, and the disclosures appear as clear printed text.
